claims: Plug the earphones into a device and gently bend the cable at various points starting from the jack to the earbuds.
Listen for any crackling sounds or audio returning in one ear to identify the exact spot of the internal break.
Check the areas near the audio jack and the earbud stems, as these are the most common points of stress and damage.

claims.text: To find where the cable is broken, play music and bend the cable along its length to locate the spot where the sound cuts out.
